stairRun.why: Straight run, top at the north end beside the kitchen and back door, bottom at the south end on a landing that opens west into the family room, beside the new door to the common hall. Evidence: the first-floor opening is at the north end; both scanned floor plans (lead inspection report, Nov 2025) draw the stair arrow rising north; the lower-level stair hall opens on its south end. 14 risers of about 7-3/8 in over an assumed 103 in floor to floor (7'-9" ceiling on A001 plus about 10 in of floor framing); 13 treads of 9 in. Clash CX-24 assumed the opposite direction (bottom at the vestibule); this reading replaces it for the model only.
